qualification: Rust-owned five-family OpenAPI HTTP projection prototype

source.contract: Rust sdk-openapi-prototype Actors, Workers, Stream, Objects and Inference documents
source.generation_mode: Rust projections were refreshed and hash-bound before the qualification run; generated Perl packages were tested from those refreshed specs

runtime.name: Strawberry Perl
runtime.license_scope: Perl distribution licensing applies; no single license is asserted for the CPAN dependency closure
runtime.dependency_install: 70 installed distribution metadata records in ignored target/perl/local-lib

package.name: acyclic-http-perl-0.1.0.zip
package.install: Five generated Perl libs plus cpanfiles installed into an isolated local-lib-contained directory

vectors: Actors invokeActor preserves actorId, method, URL and bytes/base64 AQID with generated response status 200
Workers deployment invoke preserves bytes/base64 AQID, bearer authentication, and textual uint64 boundary 18446744073709551615
Stream read exercises generated 503 error handling, explicit bounded manual recovery, AQID record bytes and max uint64 sequence
Objects put preserves request bytes/base64 AQID, completion flag, etag and size response
Inference generate preserves context bytes/base64 AQID, max uint64 request and response sequence
Unauthenticated Actors HTTP 401 raises a generated API error
tests.scope: One Rust-derived representative operation per HTTP family; this is not full Perl SDK qualification

license_scope.generated_template: OpenAPI Generator Apache-2.0 project; review generated package notices before redistribution
license_scope.perl_runtime: Strawberry Perl licensing applies to the installed runtime
license_scope.cpan_dependencies: Each CPAN distribution retains its own license; the separate 70-record local closure is listed in perl-license-closure.json and remains unreviewed for redistribution
license_scope.transport: LWP::UserAgent and its dependency licenses remain separate runtime obligations
license_scope.fixture_and_consumer: Local qualification harness is repository research code; it does not change generated package licensing

limits: HTTP/JSON projection only; no protobuf/gRPC, native or embedded behavior is qualified
Stream is qualified as polling with one explicit 503/manual retry vector; no automatic retry or operation cancellation primitive is claimed
One representative route per family was exercised; every operation and model vector remains outstanding
The generated client does not supply the Rust endpoint-pool recovery policy
No registry publication or redistributable dependency bundle is claimed
